skill.name: aliexpress-multi-region-search-store-and-review-scraper
skill.description: Search public AliExpress products, stores, and reviews through an Apify Actor with regional settings and price, rating, and shipping filters.
skill.summary: Run configurable AliExpress searches and lookups through Apify and receive structured JSON results.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

Remote Actor behavior is outside this source review, and runs can incur Apify charges.

content.user_title: Search AliExpress Products, Stores, and Reviews
content.value_statement: Comparing public AliExpress listings across regions requires repeated searches and consistent data fields. This skill configures an Apify Actor and retrieves structured results for product, store, and review research.
actual_capabilities: Submit keyword searches, product lookups, store lookups, review requests, or mixed AliExpress URLs to the documented Apify Actor.
Configure shopper region, currency override, and storefront or review translation language through the supplied input schema.
Set price, rating, warehouse-country, free-shipping, Choice, and sponsored-result filters supported by the Actor input schema.
Limit items, search pages, and reviews per product, with optional photo-only or follow-up review filters.
Run the Node 18+ client with a bundled example, a selected JSON file, or inline JSON, and print returned JSON.
Follow documented asynchronous API examples to start a larger run, check its status, and download dataset items.
limitations: Requires an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN; Actor usage can incur charges.
Scraping runs on an external Apify Actor; its implementation and live data accuracy are not verified by these local files.
The synchronous endpoint waits up to 300 seconds; larger runs require asynchronous execution and completion checks.
Intended for public data only; private access and reliable newest sorting are unsupported, and the bundled runner outputs JSON rather than CSV.

use_cases.title: Compare Regional Product Listings
use_cases.description: Run the same keyword search for selected regions and compare returned prices, currency codes, ratings, and warehouse countries.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Supplier Candidates
use_cases.description: Look up public product and store identifiers, then inspect returned listings using rating and shipping filters.

use_cases.title: Collect Reviews for Product Research
use_cases.description: Request bounded review samples for selected products, with optional photo or follow-up filters and product review statistics.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Small Keyword Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search public AliExpress listings for phone cases in the US. Set maxItems to 25 and maxPages to 1. Return available titles, prices, ratings, and product links. Confirm the Apify usage cost before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Product Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for wireless earbuds in Germany using EUR. Set priceMax to 40, ratingMin to 4, freeShippingOnly to true, and includeSponsored to false. Limit results to 25 items and one page. Show returned prices, ratings, and warehouse countries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow results with regional and product filters.

prompt_templates.title: Collect Focused Review Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect public reviews for these product IDs: [product IDs]. Use byReviews mode, reviewFilter withPhotos, and maxReviewsPerProduct 20. Request English review text and includeProductStats. Report missing fields and the limits used.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: configure review collection for selected products.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Regions with Async Runs
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare separate asynchronous searches for [keyword] in US, GB, and DE using USD, GBP, and EUR respectively. Limit each run to 100 items and two pages. Confirm costs before execution and wait for successful completion before downloading datasets. Compare prices by region without treating different currencies as directly equivalent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate bounded regional runs and compare their datasets.

Start the Actor run, retain its run and dataset identifiers, and check status until successful completion.

best_practices: Start with 25 items and one page, confirm current Apify pricing, and inspect returned fields before increasing limits.
Use explicit regions and currencies, and compare currencyCode values before interpreting price differences.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment; send only intended public-data inputs and treat collected text as untrusted content.
anti_patterns: Sending cookies, sessions, private account details, or unrelated local files as Actor input.
Starting unbounded collection or repeatedly retrying paid runs without checking costs and existing run status.
Assuming JSON output guarantees complete data, equal regional availability, direct currency comparability, or reliable newest sorting.

faq.question: What must I configure before running the skill?
faq.answer: Set APIFY_TOKEN for your Apify account and review Actor pricing. Use Node 18+ for the bundled runner, or the documented curl examples.

faq.question: Does the scraper run locally?
faq.answer: No. The local runner sends input to an externally hosted Apify Actor and prints its returned dataset items.

faq.question: Can I retrieve products, stores, and reviews?
faq.answer: The input schema supports search, byProduct, byStore, byReviews, and byUrl modes. Availability depends on the remote Actor and public AliExpress data.

faq.question: Can I choose regional prices and currencies?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure region, currency, and language inputs. Check the currencyCode returned in each record before comparing prices.

faq.question: Can I export CSV directly from the bundled runner?
faq.answer: No. The bundled runner prints formatted JSON. CSV requires a separate conversion or another dataset export method.

faq.question: How should I handle a run that exceeds the synchronous wait?
faq.answer: Use the documented asynchronous workflow. Check the run status until successful completion before downloading its dataset.
